_comment: Degenerate single-combo grid pinned to the exact params currently in eutr.go (2026-06-22 manual tuning: UseTrend1/EMA5-100, RSI6/OS30, StochK9/D1/OS20, OB on RSI65/Stoch85, Trail 1.5xATR, ATRStop 1.2xATR; regime/volume/breakeven/catstop/HTF OFF, RSI50 off). Used to walk-forward the ALREADY-CHOSEN params (no search): each train fold can only pick this combo, so pooled OOS / per-fold output measures whether the fixed config survives OOS. Fixed sizing (CatStopATRMult=0, no -risk-pct).
